description: Recovery implementation of the UI session factory client (U1): unify dashboard factory GET/PUT behind one mode-aware transport aligned with session factory save modes, migrate current-factory-definition and editor save, add import confirm choices (replace current vs create new named), unify errors, and remove POST /factories from dashboard paths.

context.customerAsk: Retry after network outage. Full spec: tasks/prd-ui-session-factory-client.md. UI session factory client (U1 recovery).
context.problem: Factory definition I/O is split across current-factory-definition, named-factory, and factory-definition. Session-scoped replace import partially landed, but PUT bodies lack save modes, import has no replace-vs-create choice, createFactory and POST /factories remain, and error mapping is duplicated.
context.solution: Add a single session-factory transport with getSessionFactory and saveSessionFactory (mode + factory), delegate current-factory-definition, wire editor save as replace-current only, extend import confirm for replace and upsert-named paths with suffixed naming, unify SessionFactoryAPIError mapping, then remove createFactory and all dashboard POST /factories usage.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard factory reads and writes use one session factory client for GET and PUT on /factory-sessions/{session_id}/factory with { mode?, factory } bodies.
Editor Save uses replace-current only on every session tab; no editor path calls upsert-named-and-activate.
Import confirm offers Replace current factory (default) and Create new named factory with resolved name shown for the create path.
No dashboard import or save flow calls POST /factories; createFactory is removed from product paths.
selectedSessionID reaches session factory save and import activation consistently with export.
Save and import map STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, INVALID_FACTORY, and related codes to consistent actionable UI errors.
Quality gate: UI typecheck, lint, and relevant unit and integration tests pass before merge.

userStories.title: Session factory transport and OpenAPI alignment
userStories.description: As a frontend maintainer, I want one module that performs session factory GET/PUT with save modes so all dashboard factory I/O shares one contract-shaped transport.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/src/api/session-factory/ exports getSessionFactory(sessionID) and saveSessionFactory({ sessionID, mode?, factory }).
PUT body is { mode?: REPLACE_CURRENT | UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE, factory } with version inside factory when required.
Transport uses currentFactorySessionPath and shared transport helpers for default and non-default sessions.
Unit tests assert HTTP method, path, and JSON body for GET and for PUT with omitted mode, REPLACE_CURRENT, and UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Delegate current-factory-definition to session factory client
userStories.description: As a feature developer, I want existing current-factory hooks to call the unified client so save and get behavior stays consistent without duplicating fetch logic.
acceptanceCriteria: getCurrentFactoryDocument and saveCurrentFactoryDocument delegate to the session factory client as thin wrappers.
SaveCurrentFactoryInput.baseVersion remains an adapter that sets factory.version on the wire body only.
React Query keys in useCurrentFactoryDefinition are unchanged unless documented in a one-line comment.
Existing current-factory-definition API unit tests pass after any required { mode, factory } body updates.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Unified session factory error mapping
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want save and import failures to use consistent error codes and messages so I can recover from stale version or busy runtime situations.
acceptanceCriteria: Session factory transport maps API errors to one normalized error surface with stable adapters for save and import callers.
STALE_FACTORY_VERSION, FACTORY_NOT_IDLE, INVALID_FACTORY, FACTORY_ALREADY_EXISTS, and NETWORK_ERROR normalize predictably.
Import preview surfaces recoverable stale-version guidance when activation returns STALE_FACTORY_VERSION.
Unit tests cover at least one mapped error per major code used by save and import.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Editor save uses replace-current only
userStories.description: As a factory editor, I want Save to always replace the factory current in my active session tab so I never accidentally create a new named factory from the graph or detail editors.
acceptanceCriteria: useSaveCurrentFactory and dependent save paths call saveSessionFactory with REPLACE_CURRENT or omit mode.
No editor or current-selection save path calls UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE.
Stale version and not-idle errors still surface in the same save dialogs and controls as before migration.
selectedSessionID is passed through to save mutations the same way as export.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser: save on default and non-default session tabs issues session-scoped PUT with replace-current semantics and no POST /factories

userStories.title: Import confirm dialog with replace vs create-new-named
userStories.description: As a dashboard operator, I want to choose whether an imported PNG replaces my session current factory or creates a new named factory so I can import without losing the active definition when I need a copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Import confirm dialog offers Replace current factory (default) and Create new named factory with accessible labels and keyboard-focusable actions.
Replace path GETs current, sets imported factory.name to session current name, and PUTs REPLACE_CURRENT with version from GET.
Create path derives name from PNG metadata, allocates suffixed names on conflict, and PUTs UPSERT_NAMED_AND_ACTIVATE omitting version when the name is new.
Dialog shows the resolved target name for the create path before confirm.
useFactoryImportActivation uses the new flow by default with no POST /factories.
App.import.test.tsx and non-default session import coverage are updated for applicable paths.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser: confirm dialog shows both actions; replace on a second tab updates only that session; create shows resolved name

userStories.title: Remove named-factory createFactory
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dead global factory creation API removed after migration so regressions to POST /factories are impossible from dashboard code.
acceptanceCriteria: createFactory is removed from named-factory/api.ts with no remaining dashboard imports.
Tests that asserted POST /factories are updated to session PUT or removed when redundant.
openapi.named-factory.test.ts reflects retired create endpoint usage from the UI perspective.
UI test network assertions show zero POST /factories during import and save flows.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
